hooks.command: echo "Branch: $(git rev-parse --abbrev-ref HEAD 2>/dev/null)" && git status --short 2>/dev/null | head -20 || true

python3 -c "
import json, sys
d = json.load(sys.stdin)
fp = d.get('tool_input', {}).get('file_path', '')
warned = ['embeddings.py', 'alembic/versions', '.env']
if fp and any(w in fp for w in warned):
    print(f'WARNING: embedding/schema/secret-sensitive path: {fp}', flush=True)
" 2>/dev/null || true

[ -f graphify-out/graph.json ] && echo '{"systemMessage":"graphify: Knowledge graph exists. Read graphify-out/GRAPH_REPORT.md for god nodes and community structure before searching raw files."}' || true
repo="$(git rev-parse --show-toplevel 2>/dev/null)" && cd "$repo" && python3 scripts/agent_job_hook.py --platform claude --event Stop
